q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time Left Until Resolution
NVIDIA issued Q2 FY2027 forward guidance on May 20, 2026 (according to the research). Today is August 23, 2026. This means:
- The guidance has already been issued and is publicly known
- Q2 FY2027 results will be reported in late August/early September 2026
- Resolution is imminent (within days/weeks)

This is essentially a **resolved or near-resolved question** — the forward guidance number already exists and was announced on May 20, 2026.

## (b) Most Likely Outcome and Why

According to the CURRENT RESEARCH provided, NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, is:
- **$91.0 billion ± 2%**
- This gives a range of approximately **$89.2 billion to $92.8 billion**

The research explicitly states this guidance was already announced. Therefore, the "forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release" will be **$91.0 billion** (the midpoint).

The research also notes:
- Wall Street expects $91.9 billion on average (within the guided range)
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue was $81.6 billion, exceeding guidance
- Analysts have made 5 upward revisions with none downward recently
- A modest beat is being projected

However, the question asks specifically what the *forward guidance* will be — not the actual result. The forward guidance has already been issued and is known to be $91.0 billion.

## (c) What Would Push the Value Lower?

There is minimal uncertainty here since the guidance was already announced:
- If the question is asking about a revised/updated guidance in a subsequent earnings call, they might lower it due to:
  - Unexpected geopolitical disruptions (China export restrictions)
  - Macro slowdown
  - Supply chain issues
- However, the research indicates upward momentum, not downward

## (d) What Would Push the Value Higher?

- A revised guidance upward in a subsequent earnings announcement (less likely given recent beats)
- The question interpretation: if asking about guidance beyond Q2 (e.g., Q3 guidance), it could be higher given growth trends
- However, the phrasing "in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release" suggests the already-announced guidance

## (e) Base Rate or Historical Reference Values

**Directly from research:** NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 forward guidance was issued on May 20, 2026, at **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, with a range of approximately $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion.

The most recent comparable data point: Q1 FY2027 actual was $81.6 billion, exceeding guidance, suggesting NVIDIA tends to guide conservatively and beat.

## Probability Distribution

Given that the guidance was already issued on May 20, 2026, at $91.0 billion ± 2%, the most likely outcome is that the forward guidance announced **in** the Q2 FY2027 earnings release will cluster around:
- The official $91.0 billion figure (highest probability)
- Within the stated ±2% range ($89.2B–$92.8B)

The range provided (99.5–115.5B) seems inconsistent with NVIDIA's actual announced guidance. The upper bound of 115.5B would represent an ~27% increase from Q1 actuals (81.6B), which would be an exceptional jump and not supported by analyst expectations showing modest beats.

My estimate concentrates probability around the known guidance of $91.0 billion:

Low (10th percentile): 89200000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 92800000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, predicts $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/) [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).

Wall Street analysts, on average, expect $91.9 billion, placing their estimates within NVIDIA's guided range. The top end of NVIDIA's guidance is approximately $92.8 billion, and the low end is around $89.2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). For Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA reported $81.6 billion in revenue, exceeding its own guidance [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Analysts are projecting a modest beat for Q2, with five upward revisions over the past month and none downward [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
